# Stepstone font

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is the standard reading and interface font.
It is hosted locally; no learner requests go to a font provider. Clear letter
shapes and generous word and line spacing are applied throughout the app.
KaTeX retains its separately licensed mathematical fonts.

The Latin variable WOFF2 was downloaded on 2026-09-24:
https://github.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next
https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/atkinsonhyperlegiblenext/v7/NaPNcYPdHfdVxJw0IfIP0lvYFqijb-UxCtm5_wdGseiJn3o.woff2

The original SIL Open Font License is included beside the font.
